svg.title: GPU-resident batched redactor pipeline
svg.desc: Eight worker threads each decode (NVDEC) and resize on the GPU, fan in to one shared TensorRT engine running preprocess, forward and postprocess at batch size up to 8, then fan back out to eight workers for mask paint, RGB to NV12, NVENC encode and ffmpeg muxing.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does GpuDecoder / NVDEC produce RGB frames in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does resize_rgb do and why CHW uint8?')
sendPrompt('How does BatchInferenceServer coalesce requests with the 4ms window?')
sendPrompt('What happens in gpu_run preprocessing — resize to 640 and /255?')
sendPrompt('How does _predict run the engine — CUDA graph vs execute_async_v3?')
sendPrompt('What does _postprocess do — conf filter, NMS, mask cleanup?')
sendPrompt('How does paint_gpu union, dilate and fill the person masks?')
sendPrompt('How does rgb_to_nv12 do BT.709 conversion on GPU with torch.compile?')
sendPrompt('How does GpuEncoder feed NV12 device buffers into NVENC?')
sendPrompt('Why pipe the NVENC elementary stream through an ffmpeg muxer?')
